notes.title: From the Creator of Save Room: The Inventory Sort Is Broken is Coming!
notes.content:
If you enjoyed organizing inventories in Save Room, I’ve got exciting news: my next game, The Inventory Sort Is Broken, takes the concept of sorting to an MMORPG universe. This time, you’ll be organizing the chaotic bags of adventurers visiting your shop.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201030/The_Auto_Sort_Is_Broken/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260902/0bdfedb7cb0cc2116d88089aa4506ff0c29c03f7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260902/691c4700e593d21b70d213554f4df910f5d27515.gif[/img]

Not only will you face the challenge of optimizing inventory space, but the game also brings a touch of humor and nostalgia from MMORPGs. NPCs will share their thoughts on the game world – and even complain about the broken “sort button” (we’ve all been there!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260902/79060b7bca6590b17ef33881c53c51d6703b979a.gif[/img]

It’s a new experience that keeps the spirit of Save Room alive, but with an RPG twist and lots of stories to tell. I hope you’ll enjoy it as much as I enjoyed creating it!

To keep up-to-date with our new releases, follow our Steam developer's page:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/39634651

notes.title: Save Room - The Merchant is coming
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are pleased to announce that the page for the new Save Room is now live! It's time to enjoy the tranquility of a save room alongside an intriguing merchant. In addition to your organizing skills, you will now also need to showcase your negotiation abilities! Feel free to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326020/Save_Room__The_Merchant/

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards are now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260902/bf28697ae9a85b5bd7384b461dca61f6de536e92.png[/img]

Our Save Room has received a new upgrade!

We are pleased to announce that Steam trading cards are available to all players!

Also, the game no longer has limited profile features. This means that achievements will contribute to your global achievement stats on your Steam profile.

Thanks for all your support, the game would be nothing without you!

To keep up-to-date with our new releases, follow our Steam developer's page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/39634651

notes.title: Mouse support and new achievements!
notes.content:
This new patch brings a much-requested feature, mouse support! Players who had difficulty just playing on the keyboard or gamepad can now be relieved.

[list]
[*]Mouse support implemented
[*]Two new secret achievements
[*]Voice logo intro
[/list]

notes.title: Finally, someone turned 'inventory tetris' into an entire videogame
notes.content: You're low on ammo. Wounded. Desperate. But you made it through the level and now you can take a deep sigh of relief and prepare for the next one. Time to heal, reload your weapons, and organize your backpack so you can fit all your gear neatly inside it... Read more.

notes.title: Bug fixes and a key remapping system.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed when you could enter the menu while an item was selected.
[*] Fixed when you could enter the menu while an item was selected to combine.
[*] A key remap system was added.
[*] Fixed issue with game crashing when changing resolution.
[/list]
